decisions.rationale: Pelizaeus-Merzbacher Disease in the title names one specific disease with a single definition and no further categorization.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1: Annotate all Specific Disease mentions

decisions.rationale: The bare word 'disease' in 'the major cause of the disease' is a very general term, and the guidelines exclude it.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4: Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: Brain Dysmyelinating Disease refers to a family of multiple dysmyelinating disorders rather than one specific disease, so it fits the Disease Class definition. It is the object of 'on' and does not modify another noun phrase.

decisions.rationale: Pelizaeus-Merzbacher Disease in the abstract refers to one specific, well-defined disease, and the span is the full name.

decisions.rationale: PMD is the abbreviation of Pelizaeus-Merzbacher Disease, a synonymous mention of the same specific disease, so it is annotated as its own mention.

decisions.rationale: X-linked developmental defect of myelination describes a family of X-linked myelination disorders that includes PMD, and it is not a single specific disease. It is comparable to the 'autosomal recessive disease' example.
